instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest Systems provides specialized rental solutions for heavy construction and power generation equipment, managing a diverse fleet of 2,500 assets across eight operational depots. The core business revolves around maximizing machine utilization through telematics and proactive maintenance scheduling rather than complex manufacturing.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing – only 8% of customers created accounts. This failure highlighted the need for deeper market validation before committing limited resources to technology development.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist three years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: We have two generalist developers who split their time between maintaining existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role – innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: The primary focus remains on maintaining operational efficiency and cash flow stability, meaning innovation efforts are heavily filtered through the lens of immediate cost reduction and low-risk market entry.

opportunities.title: Optimized Component Lifecycle Service (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing telematics data to create a micro-service focused on preventative maintenance scheduling for high-value assets. This builds upon current operational needs while providing a new recurring revenue stream.

first_actions: Identify the top 10 highest-utilization assets for pilot testing.
Develop a basic data visualization dashboard showing predictive failure indicators.
Create a tiered pricing model based on service level.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% reduction in unplanned downtime for pilot fleet within Q3.
milestones: Full rollout of predictive maintenance framework (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Niche Equipment Component Marketplace (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Capitalize on the strategic goal of diversification by creating a low-overhead B2B platform where used, specialized parts for rental equipment can be traded. This requires minimal upfront capital and taps into an adjacent asset management market.

first_actions: Conduct primary research with 50 independent heavy equipment mechanics on desired part availability.
Develop a simple web-based listing platform (MVP) focused solely on parts sourcing.
Identify 3 regional markets for initial operational focus.
resources_needed: Basic cloud hosting and developer time
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 10 active part listings per month by end of Year 1.
milestones: Launch MVP marketplace on internal platform (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Specialized Asset Leasing Channel (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Target the high-margin industrial sector (e.g., specialized logistics firms) by offering bespoke long-term equipment leases tailored to their specific operational cycles, moving beyond standard short/long-term rentals.

first_actions: Define 2 potential adjacent target industries with high CapEx needs.
Create a streamlined sales proposal focusing on total cost of ownership (TCO) rather than simple rental rates.
Develop simplified contractual templates for long-term agreements.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot long-term contracts representing 5% of total revenue.

next_steps.action: Initiate a focused market research sprint on used equipment parts and potential acquisition targets.
Define KPIs for the predictive maintenance pilot project using current telematics data.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated R&D headcount, leading to reliance on opportunistic development cycles.
Informal innovation process that lacks structured prioritization and formal assessment gates.
Low digital maturity (Level 1), hindering scalable customer experience initiatives.
Significant capital constraint requiring all new ventures to demonstrate immediate cash flow ROI.
